description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_CreditScoring" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Level1Result" name="Level 1 scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DelayNotice" name="Scoring delay notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Level2Result" name="Level 2 scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Banking System" processRef="Process_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest" sourceRef="SendTask_ScoringRequest" targetRef="Participant_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Level1Result" name="Level 1 result" messageRef="Msg_Level1Result" sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="CatchEvent_Level1Result"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotice" sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="CatchEvent_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Level2Result" name="Level 2 result" messageRef="Msg_Level2Result" sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="CatchEvent_Level2Result"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Bank" name="Banking System Credit Scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Bank">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesClerk" name="Sales Clerk (Frontend)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Clerk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_RequestScoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_PresentLevel1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_DisplayDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_PresentLevel2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Level1Presented</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Level2Presented</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BankingSystem" name="Banking System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_ScoringRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventGateway_Response</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CatchEvent_Level1Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CatchEvent_DelayNotice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CatchEvent_Level2Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Clerk" name="Credit scoring requested"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_RequestScoring" name="Request credit scoring for customer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EventGateway_Response" name="Scoring response?" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_Level1Result" name="Level 1 result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Level1Result" messageRef="Msg_Level1Result"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DelayNotice" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotice"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_PresentLevel1" name="Display result to clerk"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Level1Presented" name="Immediate result presented"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_DisplayDelay" name="Display delay message to clerk (check again later)"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_Level2Result" name="Level 2 result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Level2Result" messageRef="Msg_Level2Result"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_PresentLevel2" name="Display result to clerk"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Level2Presented" name="Delayed result presented"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Clerk" targetRef="UserTask_RequestScoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="UserTask_RequestScoring" targetRef="SendTask_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="SendTask_ScoringRequest" targetRef="EventGateway_Response"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="EventGateway_Response" targetRef="CatchEvent_Level1Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="EventGateway_Response" targetRef="CatchEvent_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="CatchEvent_Level1Result" targetRef="UserTask_PresentLevel1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="UserTask_PresentLevel1" targetRef="EndEvent_Level1Presented"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="CatchEvent_DelayNotice" targetRef="UserTask_DisplayDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="UserTask_DisplayDelay" targetRef="CatchEvent_Level2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="CatchEvent_Level2Result" targetRef="UserTask_PresentLevel2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="UserTask_PresentLevel2" targetRef="EndEvent_Level2Presented"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
